prompt: theCore STM32F407G-DISC1 STLINK V2.1 OpenOCD config file
answer:
For the STM32F407G-DISC1 with ST-LINK/V2.1, use:

```bash
openocd -f board/stm32f429disc1.cfg
```

The theCore debugger configuration is:

```bash
tcore flash --sudo --debugger-config stlink-v2.1
```
